_comment: Ratchet only. Baseline was origin/main 9218d38c; ratcheted after the explicit-arithmetic unit/relation/sign and claim-attribution fixes. Lower a max or raise a min when a fix improves the replay; never loosen. Loosened once on purpose for the claim hole (review blocker 3): a claim number with a linked quantity's dimension that the claim does not attribute must be explained by the plan or the question, which rejects op4's unexplained 'refracted angle 90°' (5 lanes, op4#1 to fallback, asked correct 105 to 104, missing 4 to 5) and nlm1 r1 alternate's 'net force 17.6 N' (1 lane). Loosened again on purpose for review findings P1-a/P1-c (safety first): claim numbers are now read in every unit the plan's unit parser knows (s, m/s, mA, µT, kg, kPa, m^3/s^2, powers of ten), and a claim subject is read across 'of' and after the quantity's name. Six more lanes are rejected, each for a claim number that disagrees with the verified value: grav3 r1 alternate (plan GM 3.92e14 vs claim 4.01408e14), grav3 r2 alternate (reconcile rewrote GM to 4.01408e8 from R_e in km; the claim's 4.01408e14 m^3/s^2 caught it), fl2 r1/r2 alternate (claims kept the stale 3.29 and 9.98 cm/s after reconcile), th5 r1 primary and alternate (claims state 483 and 483.6 m/s against a reconciled 483.67 m/s). th5#1 loses both lanes and goes to fallback: asked correct 104 to 103, missing 5 to 6, fallback 3 to 4, rejected 16 to 22, claim mismatch 15 to 21. askedUnconvertible counts asked values whose unit does not convert to the truth unit; they score wrong, never correct. Ratcheted after the mixed-unit and claim-precision fixes: a chain whose inputs mix units (6400 km inside g R_e^2 for an SI GM) is read by dimensional analysis and never rewritten through the literal reading, so grav3 r2 alternate keeps GM = 4.01408e14 and is accepted; a claim number matches its quantity rounded at the claim's own precision or truncated there at three or more significant figures, so th5 r1 '483 m/s' and '483.6 m/s' against 483.67 m/s pass and th5#1 leaves the fallback. Rejected 22 to 19, claim mismatch 21 to 18, fallback 4 to 3, asked correct 103 to 104, missing 6 to 5. nonAskedRewritesByFactor counts rewrites of non-asked values by a power of ten (the unit slip shape; non-asked values have no truth to score); it was 1 (grav3 r2 alternate GM x1e-6) and is held at 0. The optics law audit is report only: it never changes a plan value, so opticsRightToWrong and opticsQuantityRightToWrong (both 0, and 0 optics corrections on this replay) are replaced by opticsChangedLanes, held at 0, which fails if the audit ever changes any plan value. The audit now rejects a lane whose value disagrees with an unambiguously evaluated optics law (optics_law_mismatch); opticsLawMismatchLanes and opticsRejectedRightLanes are held at 0 (no lane on this replay disagrees with a law).
